plan.title: PR assignee list by category visibility

steps.note: Enable the required PR team-category filtering configuration for this case.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the starting screen for the PR selection flow.
Stay on the Open tab, where PRs can be selected for assignment.
Select the first specified Fruits PR.
Select the second specified Fruits PR while retaining the multi-selection.
Select the third specified Fruits PR while retaining the multi-selection.
Open the assignee picker for the selected PRs.
Verify that the Search a user box opened.
Verify the food-category buyer is offered.
Verify the fruits-category buyer is offered.
Verify the all-category buyer is offered.
Verify the super admin is offered.
Verify the process validator is offered.
Scroll to the end of the assignee list so the complete list is traversed.
Verify the engineering-category buyer is excluded by team filtering.
